frames_per_second.description: Frames per second of the generated video.

num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps. Defaults to 15 and can be increased up to 30.

generate_audio.description: Whether to include audio in the returned video. When disabled, the final MP4 is returned without an audio track.

video_quality.description: The quality preset of the generated video.

video_url.description: The URL of the source video to transform.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. The default is tuned for fast, high-quality generation.

num_frames.description: The number of output frames. Output duration is num_frames / frames_per_second. The IC-LoRA control budget caps the resolution x frames volume: roughly 6s at 720p or 15s at 480p; a request above it returns a 422 (lower num_frames, or use 480p).

sync_mode.description: If True, the media is returned as a data URI inline in the response. Useful for short-lived requests and tests.

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt to steer generation away from.
negative_prompt.default: color distortion, overexposure, static, blurry details, subtitles, style, artwork, painting, frame, still, dim overall tone, worst quality, low quality, JPEG compression artifacts, ugly, mutilated, extra fingers, poorly drawn hands, poorly drawn face, deformed, disfigured, malformed limbs, fused fingers, motionless frame, cluttered background, three legs, crowded background, walking backwards

enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker.

prompt.description: Optional short description of the video's content/scene. It is woven into the effect's trained caption to sharpen the result; leave empty to apply the effect with a generic description.

resolution.description: Output resolution (short side), preserving the source aspect ratio. The IC-LoRA control path caps the resolution x frames volume, so resolution trades against duration: 720p allows up to ~6s (sharper), 480p up to ~15s (softer but longer). A request above the budget is rejected with a clear error — pick 480p for longer clips. Output duration is num_frames / frames_per_second.

video_write_mode.description: The write mode of the generated video.

input.description:
Shared input for the Creative-Lab video-to-video effect IC-LoRAs.

The source ``video_url`` is fed straight into the IC-LoRA guide and
re-rendered through the effect adapter (colorization, deblur,
decompression, instant-shave, water-simulation, day-to-night, cross-eyed,
clean-plate).
Each endpoint bakes in its LoRA and its trained caption convention, so the
public ``prompt`` is just an optional scene description that is woven into
that caption. Runs on the distilled 8-step path; prompt expansion is
bypassed so the trained caption reaches the model verbatim.
